intro: Austin storage listings routinely advertise a 10x10 from about $20 or "first month $1", but the market rate for a non-climate 10x10 sits around $95–$112/month, and existing-customer increases of 15–40% are commonly reported a few months after move-in. Here is what the first six months typically cost once fees and the first increase are included.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Deepest promos are often on small units; fixed fees ($29 admin + protection) are a large share of the true cost here. Climate control adds roughly $5–$10.
Walk-in closet; a studio's boxes and small furniture. Climate-controlled average ~$78–$87.
Most rented size (one-bedroom apartment). Climate-controlled average ~$104–$132. Sources disagree by ~$17, so get quotes.
Three-bedroom house or a car. Climate-controlled average ~$207–$233; drive-up units are often cheaper.

local_tips: Austin summers routinely pass 100°F; for wood furniture, electronics, documents or vinyl, budget for climate control (roughly +$10–$30/month on a 10x10).
Facilities on the US-290, US-183 and I-35 corridors show the lowest listed promos; central/East Austin (e.g. Airport Blvd) listings run noticeably higher for the same size.
Market rates in Austin fell slightly year over year (StorageCafe: -1.8% for 10x10), which gives you room to negotiate when an increase notice arrives.
